title: Points Already Used at a Month-End Expiry Run: Recent Redemptions and Returned Payments — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
At a Service Accounts and Repair Orders month-end points expiry run, the points already used — the points set against the aged points — follow the account's recent activity.

| Account | Recent activity | Points already used |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | Points were redeemed within the last 6 whole months | every point already expired plus the points redeemed before that window; the redemptions of those months are drawn from points earned since and are not set against the aged points |
| Below Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | A returned payment was posted within the last twelve whole months | every point already expired, every point redeemed, and the points earned on the repair order of the latest returned payment, which are treated as used as well |
| Otherwise | — | every point expired and every point redeemed |

**Windows.** A record falls within the last whole months named when fewer than that many whole months separate its date from the day the run is made, so records dated on that day count. Whole months are counted as complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Latest returned payment.** Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. The points earned on its repair order are the points of every points-earned entry for that repair order.

**Cases (hypothetical, run made 31 October).**
- Gold account; 2000 redeemed ever, 700 of them on 12 June; 400 expired before. June is inside the 6-month window, so the points already used are 400 plus 1300, that is 1700.
- Silver account; a check returned on 3 March on a repair order that earned 640 points; 900 redeemed and 0 expired: the points already used are 1540.
